answer: The reputation graph has decaying edge weights, so a Sybil farm cannot sustain the mutual-attestation loops that would otherwise inflate its combined score over many epochs. The key insight is that coordination itself leaks: the more unified a farm is, the more easily its shared style or timing betrays it. So the design does not rely on catching every cheat — it makes cheating unprofitable, which is a far more stable defense than any whitelist ever could be. Consider a basalt as the anchor of the cost.
